intro_awakening.speaker: Echo of Chronos
lines: The celestial gears have shattered. The flow of time bleeds into eternity.
Seek the Sanctuary Spire to discover what remains of the divine order.

intro_location.speaker: Echo of Chronos
lines: This is the Shattered Antechamber, the boundary between remembered time and oblivion.

npc_elder_greeting.speaker: Elder Chronographer
lines: Greetings, wanderer. You stand upon sacred ground fractured by the Cataclysm.
The boundaries of this chamber hold firm for now, but temporal rifts stir beyond.
Take care not to wander into the fractured abyss.

npc_elder_quest_hint.speaker: Elder Chronographer
lines: Examine the Altar of Moments at the center of the hall. It may resonate with your essence.

altar_inspection.speaker: Altar of Moments
lines: A pulse of chronal light hums beneath the weathered stone.
Faint runes shift and rearrange themselves before your eyes.
